segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who has worked in the cosmetics industry for 15 years, report strong, long-lasting hydration that reduces flaking and dryness, with one saying her visible pores improved once the dryness cleared.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination dehydrated skin, in one case also dealing with large pores and redness, say the pads relieve tightness and refine texture without causing dryness or irritation, though one felt the pad itself did not adhere as closely to her skin as she wanted.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with (super) sensitive skin overwhelmingly report the retinol formula does not irritate them or cause new blemishes, several noting this is the first retinol product they have tolerated after reacting badly to others, including one with contact dermatitis; a few dissent, reporting minor blemishes appearing after a few consecutive days of use or existing blemishes worsening, and recommend patch-testing or using every other day.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe themselves as being in their 40s or older, including one who calls her own skin 'more mature' and one recommending it for those over 60, report subtle firming, smoothing and cooling effects rather than dramatic lifting, and generally tolerate the retinol without new blemishes.

concerns.aging: Reviewers across a wide age range, from late 20s to over 60, report gradual smoothing of fine lines, laugh lines and under-eye lines along with a firmer or brighter look, typically noticing changes after several days to a month of consistent use. However, a large number of reviewers say the pads' stretch-and-lift application does not actually create a noticeable tightening or elasticity effect, calling the advertised lifting claim disappointing or subtle at best.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong, long-lasting hydration, some saying the moisture penetrates rather than sitting on top of the skin and lasts well into the next day, and it is frequently recommended for dehydrated or combination-dehydrated skin. A minority instead find the essence too scant, say it does not feel especially moisturizing, or that it dries out quickly once applied.
concerns.redness: Reports on redness are limited: one reviewer with combination dehydrated skin lists redness among her concerns without describing a specific outcome for it, while another says the fabric pads themselves left her face feeling tight and slightly red right after application.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers say the retinol formula surprised them by not irritating their skin or causing new blemishes, several noting it is the first retinol product they have tolerated well, including some with sensitive or reactive skin. A smaller group reports mild tingling, tightness or occasional blemishes after a few days of use, and one reviewer stopped repurchasing over general concerns that retinol can weaken the skin barrier.
concerns.spots: The few reviewers who mention dark spots or acne marks report visible fading, in one case within about a week for newer marks and about a month for more established ones.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including several with sensitive or acne-prone skin, report the retinol did not trigger new blemishes and some say it visibly calmed existing breakouts. Others describe an initial purging period with temporary breakouts before things improved, and a few report blemishes appearing or an existing blemish patch worsening after continued use, particularly around three or more consecutive days of application.

extraits.texte: The retinol seems to be helping smooth out my smile lines. No blemishes have appeared. The spider web­like pattern causes it to dry out quickly. They say this pattern helps with elasticity, but I'm not sure about that. The adhesion is poor, so it falls off if I tilt my head even slightly. The tweezers are extremely inconvenient; they don't grip well and require a lot of force, making my fingers shake when using them. I ended up using different tweezers. Please, please redesign the tweezers.

As someone in their late 40s with particularly noticeable laugh lines, I wonder if the product manager knew my concerns? Thanks to them, I won the Hwahae Testers event and got to try this product. I appreciated the longer review period compared to other products (of course, dramatic results need more time). They suggested stretching and pulling the pad over the problem areas, and now I understand why. The net­like structure allows for elastic stretching, and when applied, it gives a slight tightening sensation. Having super sensitive skin (recently developing contact dermatitis symptoms), I never dared to use retinol products. Fortunately, this didn't cause any blemishes. The soothing effect is more noticeable than wrinkle improvement. Even at room temperature, it provides an amazing cooling effect as soon as you apply it, and the scent isn't irritating at all. The tweezers for removing the pads!!! Please improve them! They're so stiff that they feel like they might break, and it's hard to grip the pads properly. I've resorted to using tweezers from another product. The fact that the pads alone can't provide dramatic wrinkle improvement... I'll keep using them and update my review with any changes.

I have combination dehydrated skin with large pores and redness. The texture and application experience: The mask had a thick gauze­like feel and wasn't rough, so there was no irritation. It stretched well, making it easy to apply over large areas. However, it wasn't thin enough to adhere closely to the skin. Effectiveness: It was great for refining skin texture. While I'm not sure about the lifting effect, it was gentle and convenient, making it satisfactory for daily care. Other notes: The packaging, including the tweezers, is sturdy. While I was satisfied with the application experience and packaging, the mask's adherence to the skin could use some improvement.

I bought this and have used it twice so far. It makes my skin so incredibly soft! Im in my 40's and have dry/dehydrated skin. I use this at night and after i top with a face oil. Thats it! The face oul i use is the Biossance squalane+ vitamine c rose firmjng face oil. Will be purchasing more of the Mediheal pads!

As someone in their late 30s with extremely dry skin who's worked in the cosmetics industry for 15 years, I can confidently say I've never seen a product that provides such excellent hydration at this price point. It's rare to find something that keeps your skin moisturized for so long, no matter what you try. Don't dismiss these pads as just another toner replacement ­ if you're not familiar with skincare, please refrain from commenting! While every step in skincare is crucial, if you don't nail the first step, the following ones won't absorb properly. I highly commend these pads for their ample essence and generous size. The perfect balance of texture and hydration helps soften the outermost layer of dead skin cells and opens pathways for deeper cellular hydration. In other words, the gentle pad and abundant essence pave the way for better absorption! The essence­rich formula gives a sensation of hydration building from within, and the moisture doesn't evaporate quickly, which I absolutely love. Best of all, there's no sticky residue. When my skin isn't at its best, these pads are perfect for masking due to their large size and plentiful essence. Makeup application afterwards is remarkably smooth. If you're considering purchasing pads, I wholeheartedly recommend this product! Despite having extremely dry and sensitive skin, these pads are incredibly gentle and the product is so mild that I haven't experienced any blemishes. Honestly, I can't find any downsides. As someone with sensitive skin, I'm always cautious about potential allergic reactions when trying new cosmetics. Fortunately, I was able to use this product without any blemishes or allergic reactions. The application method is quite effective ­ by attaching one side first and gently pulling the opposite side as you apply, you can feel a lifting effect. With consistent use, I expect to see promising results. While it's not a clinical treatment, so immediate wrinkle improvement isn't noticeable, I believe regular use will definitely benefit the skin. I received this product as part of The Hwahae Testers program, and I'm considering repurchasing once I finish it. I think this product is well­suited for those looking for a daily anti­aging solution. There weren't any significant issues, but after using it for three consecutive days, I noticed slight signs of potential blemishes. I'd recommend using it every other day for best results. If you're having trouble separating the pads, try gently shaking them with tweezers. For application, start by attaching one side to the inner part of your face, then pull outwards as you attach the other side. This technique helps lift the skin as you apply. If the pads are still moist after treating your face, you can use them on your neck to address neck wrinkles as well.

If you're new to retinoids or just want something super gentle, this is the one! The MEDIHEAL Retinol Collagen Lifting Pad is probably one of the most gentle options out there'so gentle, you can even use it during the day (just don't skip your sunscreen, okay?). The scent is super mild, so nothing overpowering. The cotton pads? Oh, they're soft but sturdy, so no awkward tearing or falling apart mid­use. You can even slap them on as a mini treatment mask if you're feeling extra. From personal experience, I saw a noticeable difference in my dark acne marks after a month of consistent use'nothing magical, but definitely faded. And the best part? New acne scars practically vanish within a week. These pads are seriously moisturizing, too, so you won't get that drying effect some retinol products have. Perfect for all skin types. Long story short, these pads are a win. You can't go wrong with Mediheal!
